knowledge_chunks.text: General Operations & Business Management Standards: Healthy operating margin benchmarks range from 10% to 20%. Statistical anomaly tolerances should be maintained under 3.0% of total transactional volume to ensure predictable organizational performance.

Operational Anomaly Triage Protocol: Data points deviating by more than 3 standard deviations indicate process breakdowns, irregular batch executions, or data entry errors. Immediate root-cause containment is required within 48 hours.

Strategic Transformation Protocol: Maximize corporate efficiency by concentrating resources on primary correlation drivers, standardizing high-variance processes, and establishing continuous automated governance.
